description:
Merchants can refund a completed payment.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A refund cannot exceed the original payment.
2. Refunding twice with the same Idempotency-Key returns the first refund.
3. Only the merchant can refund, as set by @ana.

## Notes

- Refund emails are out of scope.
